title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12333)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12333) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12333). This Indian Standard {First Revision), which is identical with ISO 6731 : 1989 'Milk, cream and evaporated milk — Determination of total solids content (Reference method)' issued by the Irrternational Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the the recommendation of the Dairy Products and Equipment Sectional Committee and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. This standard was first published in 1988, based on ISO/DIS 6731. With the publication of ISO standard, namely, ISO 6731 : 1 989, this standard is also being revised to align it with the ISO standard. This revision incorporates, among others, the following major changes : a) Apparatus requirement in terms of water bath has been modified. b) Definition of total solids has been made more explicit. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
